title: How Should Agents See Code? Rethinking Code Representations for Agentic Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.07286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for repository-level software engineering tasks. However, most agents still access repositories through raw files, lexical search, and shell commands, treating code primarily as text. This paper investigates map-based code-representation workflows as a design variable in agentic software engineering, examining how different repository views change agents' retrieval behavior, task success, token use, and latency.   In this paper, we study five code-representation workflows: abstract syntax trees, call graphs, module dependencies, documentation-enriched search, and a hybrid workflow that combines them. Each workflow exposes a repository map that the agent can query during a task. We evaluate Claude Code with Haiku 4.5 against a raw-tool baseline on four repository-level tasks: fault localization with LinuxFLBench, repository-level code generation and repair with SWE-bench Pro, test generation with SWT-ben

translated_title: 智能体应如何“看”代码？重新思考面向智能体软件工程的代码表示
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体正越来越多地被用于仓库级软件工程任务。然而，大多数智能体仍通过原始文件、词法搜索和shell命令来访问代码仓库，主要将代码视为纯文本。本文将基于“地图”式代码表示的工作流作为智能体软件工程中的一个设计变量进行研究，考察不同的仓库视图如何改变智能体的检索行为、任务成功率、token消耗和延迟。本文研究了五种代码表示工作流：抽象语法树、调用图、模块依赖、文档增强搜索，以及将它们结合起来的混合工作流。每种工作流都为智能体提供了一张可在任务执行期间查询的仓库地图。我们在四个仓库级任务上，使用搭载Haiku 4.5的Claude Code与原始工具基线进行对比评估：利用LinuxFLBench进行故障定位、利用SWE-bench Pro进行仓库级代码生成与修复、利用SWT-bench进行测试生成（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文将基于地图的代码表示（抽象语法树、调用图、模块依赖、文档增强搜索及其混合形式）作为智能体软件工程的设计变量，系统评估了五种代码表示工作流如何影响智能体的检索行为、任务成功率、token消耗与延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates five map-based code-representation workflows (abstract syntax trees, call graphs, module dependencies, documentation-enriched search, and a hybrid) as a design variable in agentic software engineering, showing how different repository views affect agents' retrieval behavior, task success, token usage, and latency.
